title: ScanRobot 2.0 MDS: Scanning very thick books up to 15 cm (6 inch)
summary: A demo of the Treventus ScanRobot 2.0 MDS, an automatic book scanner that digitizes very thick books up to 15 cm with gentle handling.
why: HN brings it up in book-digitization threads as an elegant, careful scanner design.

quote.text: I always thought the Treventus ScanRobot was an elegant way to scan books
